title: Premium
wikitext:
IdleCorp Premium

Premium is a way for you to directly contribute financially to the developer of this amazing and continuously growing bot. Your donation helps cover server costs and 1% of your payment is contributed to reducing CO2 levels in the environment! You can play this amazing game while simultaneously supporting the dev AND helping the environment with one of these subscriptions!

The in-game bonuses you receive for each level are worth every cent. Many levels of commitment and contribution are available for choice, and you will not have to deal with monthly payments like other subscription-based systems. All levels are available on a monthly, semi-annual, or yearly basis.

|-

|}

== IdleCorp Platinum ==

$5.99USD per month

Permanent Voter’s Boon

Custom names for retail products

Access to $$[[give]] command. Give directly to another corporation without having to sell through the public live market but through a safe transfer of funds or assets.

Access to IdleCorp testverse

4x Multiplier on Vote rewards

Increased Reincorporation limit to 25 Tokens

Increased Market slots to 8

Daily Platinum pass challenge (worth 150 XP if completed)

Claim weekly reward of 3 Tokens


== IdleCorp Gold ==

$3.99USD per month

Permanent Voter’s Boon

Custom names for retail products

Access to $$[[give]] command. Give directly to another corporation without having to sell through the public live market but through a safe transfer of funds or assets.

Access to IdleCorp testverse

3x Multiplier on Vote rewards

Increased Reincorporation limit to 20 Tokens

Increased Market slots to 6

Daily Gold pass challenge (worth 100 XP if completed)

Claim weekly reward of 2 Tokens

== IdleCorp+ ==

$1.99USD per month

Permanent Voter’s Boon

Custom names for retail products

Access to $$[[give]] command. Give directly to another corporation without having to sell through the public live market but through a safe transfer of funds or assets.

Access to IdleCorp testverse

2x Multiplier on Vote rewards

Increased Reincorporation limit to 15 Tokens

Increased Market slots to 4

Daily Plus pass challenge (worth 100 XP if completed)

Claim weekly reward of 1 Token

This package can also be received for being a Nitro subscriber and boosting the IdleCorp HQ server.

== Gratitude Points ==

These bundles have a cooldown period upon purchasing before you can purchase the same bundle again.

{|
| 80x+40x || $9.99USD
|-
| 40x+10x || $4.99USD
|-
| 8x || $0.99USD
|}

== Note from the Developer ==

“If you feel like I deserve a little bit of monetary support for my work on IdleCorp, you can subscribe to one of our premium memberships available at https://idlecorp.xyz/#/premium for extra in-game benefits including [[Voting#Voter's Boon|Voter’s Boon]] without needing to vote!
No worries if you can’t, I’ll continue to support and develop IdleCorp for as long as I can!“
-Teemaw
